source_notes: Bay District Schools posts its agendas and minutes on BoardDocs at https://go.boarddocs.com/fl/bcsdfl/Board.nsf/vpublic?open (linked from the district's 'School Board Meetings' page; bay.k12.fl.us itself blocks automated requests with a JavaScript challenge). Minutes were read from the BoardDocs minutes view and the printable detailed agenda for every Board of Education meeting from Jan. 9, 2024 through Sept. 22, 2026. The Oct. 13, 2026 minutes were not yet posted.

BoardDocs minutes list every motion with 'Yes:' and 'No:' names, so by_member comes straight from the minutes. A member missing from both lists is marked absent; the meeting's 'Members present' line was checked for those cases.

Amounts come from the staff cover memo or backup attachment for each item (many attachments are scanned; their text was produced by OCR). The minutes themselves do not state amounts. Contract totals are the figures the staff memo asked the board to approve.

Included: every tentative and final budget and millage vote for FY2024-25, FY2025-26 and FY2026-27; separately voted construction prices (GMPs), purchases and contracts of roughly $500,000 or more; land, easement and property-insurance items; and every non-unanimous or failed vote (all subjects). Routine consent items, which the minutes list without amounts, are not included. Procedural motions (agenda approval, adjournment) are skipped except the one split agenda vote.

Overlap: votes.json already has two news-based school board entries (2024-09-10 FY2025 final budget and 2025-07-31 FY2026 tentative millage). The entries here for those meetings come from the official minutes with roll calls and should replace them.

votes.plain_summary: Adopted a $639.9 million school budget for 2026-27. Vote 5-0.

votes.summary: The final 2026-27 budget for all funds totals $639,909,531.31, down $10,945,485.67, or 1.7%, from 2025-26.

votes.source_title: Bay District School Board Budget Workshop, Budget Meeting and Budget Hearing minutes, 2026-09-10 (BoardDocs, item 'E. Resolution No. 27-03 - A Resolution of the Bay County School Board Adopting the Millage Rates for Fiscal Year 2026-20')

votes.plain_summary: Rejected $3.05 million MacBook purchase for students. Vote 2-3; Ann Leonard, Chris Moore, Jerry Register voted no.
